info.title: NelcotaCloud API
info.description: Multitenant Auth: every request names its tenant with an API key.

201.description: Tenant created; its API keys are shown only here

400.description: Invalid slug, name or site URL

delete.summary: `DELETE /admin/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}`: deletes the tenant, its users and its database.

get.summary: `GET /admin/api-keys`: every key of the tenant, newest first, without the keys themselves.

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

post.summary:
`POST /admin/api-keys`: a new key next to the existing ones, so apps can switch to it
before the old one is revoked. The key is shown only in this response.

201.description: Key created; store it now, it is not shown again

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

delete.summary: `DELETE /admin/api-keys/{key_id}`: the key stops working at once.

parameters.name: key_id
parameters.description: Id of the key to revoke

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

404.description: No active key with this id

409.description: It is the last active secret key

get.summary: `GET /admin/oauth`: the providers the tenant has its own OAuth app for, without secrets.

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

put.summary: `PUT /admin/oauth/{provider}`: the tenant registers its own OAuth app (secret key only).

204.description: Provider configured with the tenant's own OAuth app

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

delete.summary: `DELETE /admin/oauth/{provider}`: the tenant stops offering login with this provider.

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project
Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

patch.summary: `PATCH /admin/settings` (secret key only): changes only the fields that are sent.

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

post.summary:
`POST /admin/signing-keys/rotate`: a new key signs from now on; tokens signed by the
previous key keep verifying until they expire.

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

get.summary: `GET /admin/smtp`: where the tenant's auth emails are sent from, without credentials.

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

put.summary: `PUT /admin/smtp`: auth emails of the tenant go through its own SMTP server.
put.description:
The server must be on a public host and an SMTP port, so the API cannot be used to reach
services inside its own network.

400.description: Invalid URL or sender, or a private host or port

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

delete.summary: `DELETE /admin/smtp`: auth emails go through the platform's SMTP server again.

204.description: Back to the platform's SMTP server

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

post.summary: `POST /admin/smtp/test`: sends a test email through the tenant's own SMTP server.
post.description:
Waits for the server to accept the message, so the owner sees a delivery problem right
away. Only for a configured server: the platform's server is not offered as a free relay.

204.description: The SMTP server accepted the test email

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

409.description: The project uses the platform's SMTP server

502.description: The SMTP server refused or could not be reached

get.summary: `GET /admin/users`: the tenant's users, newest first, optionally searched by email.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Part of the email to search for.

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project
Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

delete.summary: `DELETE /admin/users/{user_id}`: removes the user with their identities and sessions.

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

post.summary: `POST /admin/users/{user_id}/ban`: no more logins or refreshes, and every session ends.

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

post.summary: `POST /admin/users/{user_id}/logout`: ends every session; access tokens expire on their own.

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

delete.summary:
`DELETE /admin/users/{user_id}/mfa`: removes the user's authenticator (e.g. a lost phone),
after the tenant confirmed who they are by its own means.

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

post.summary: `POST /admin/users/{user_id}/unban`: the user can log in again.

403.description: Requires the secret API key, or membership in the project

get.summary:
Public keys of the tenant, so other services can verify access tokens without calling us.
The document is serialized once per key set and shared by every response.

200.description: The tenant's public keys (JWKS) to verify access tokens

post.summary: `POST /login`: email and password.

200.description: Logged in, or the MFA step that must come first

403.description: Email not verified yet

post.summary: Always answers 204, even for unknown tokens, so the endpoint cannot be used to probe tokens.

`POST /magic-link`: emails a one-time login link. An unknown email gets a passwordless
account, so the same call signs people up; the answer never reveals which case it was.

202.description: A login link is on its way

post.summary: `POST /magic-link/verify`: trades the token from the emailed link for a session.
post.description:
Opening the link proves control of the inbox. On an account nobody verified, whoever set
its password may not own the email, so the password is dropped and its sessions end.

200.description: Logged in, or the MFA step that must come first

403.description: The user is banned

get.summary: `GET /mfa`: the second factors of the logged-in user.

post.summary:
`POST /mfa/challenge`: the second step of a login with MFA on. Each challenge allows a few
wrong codes; after that the login starts over.

400.description: Unknown, expired or exhausted MFA token

post.summary: `POST /mfa/totp`: starts adding a TOTP authenticator (replacing a pending one). Shown once.

201.description: Authenticator created; verify it with a first code

delete.summary:
`DELETE /mfa/totp`: turns TOTP off. A current code is required, so a stolen access token
alone cannot remove the second factor.

401.description: Wrong code or invalid access token

post.summary: `POST /mfa/totp/verify`: the first code turns the pending authenticator on.

204.description: TOTP enabled; logins now ask for a code

401.description: Wrong code or invalid access token

get.summary: `GET /oauth/callback`: the provider sends the browser here.
get.description:
On success the browser goes back to the app with a short-lived `code` (exchanged at
`POST /oauth/token` with the app's PKCE verifier), never with tokens in the URL; on
failure, with an `error` code.

303.description: Redirects back to the app with a one-time `code`, or an `error`

post.summary:
`POST /oauth/token`: trades the one-time code from the OAuth redirect for a session. The
code is consumed even when the verifier is wrong, so it cannot be guessed against.

200.description: Logged in, or the MFA step that must come first

401.description: Invalid or expired code, or wrong code verifier

get.summary: `GET /oauth/{provider}/authorize`: redirects the browser to the provider's sign-in page.

parameters.name: apikey
parameters.description: The publishable key travels in the query: this endpoint is opened by a browser redirect.

parameters.name: code_challenge_method
parameters.description: Only S256 is supported; it may be omitted.

303.description: Redirects the browser to the provider's sign-in page

400.description: Invalid redirect, PKCE challenge or provider not configured

post.summary: `POST /recover`: emails a password reset link.

202.description: A reset link is sent if the email has an account

post.summary:
`POST /refresh`: rotates the refresh token. The presented token is consumed first, so a
refused refresh (e.g. email verification now required) also ends that session.

200.description: New tokens; the refresh token sent is no longer valid

401.description: Invalid, expired, reused or revoked refresh token

403.description: Email not verified yet

post.summary:
`POST /reset-password`: consuming the link, setting the password and ending every session
happen in one transaction, so a failure leaves the link usable and nothing half done.

204.description: Password changed and every session ended

400.description: Invalid or expired token, or weak password

get.summary: `GET /sessions`: where the logged-in user is logged in, most recently used first.

delete.summary: `DELETE /sessions`: logs out every other device, keeping the session of this request.
`DELETE /sessions/{session_id}`: logs one device out; its access token expires on its own.

404.description: No such session of this user

post.summary: `POST /signup`.

201.description: Account created and logged in (email verification off)

202.description: Check the inbox; same answer for new and existing emails

delete.summary:
`DELETE /user`: the logged-in user deletes their own account and all its data (the right
to erasure). Their access token stops working once it no longer matches a user.

post.summary: `POST /verify-email`: consuming the link and marking the email verified are one transaction.
`POST /verify-email/resend`: emails a new verification link to an unverified account.

202.description: A link is sent if the email has an unverified account

get.summary: `GET /platform/v1/invitations`: invitations sent to the console account's email.

401.description: Missing or invalid platform access token

delete.summary:
`DELETE /platform/v1/invitations/{invitation_id}`: declines an invitation sent to the
account's email.

404.description: No pending invitation for this account

post.summary:
`POST /platform/v1/invitations/{invitation_id}/accept`: joins the project. The invitation
must have been sent to the email of the account's verified token.

404.description: No pending invitation for this account

get.summary: `GET /platform/v1/projects`: the projects the console account is a member of.

401.description: Missing or invalid platform access token

503.description: The platform API is not configured

post.summary:
`POST /platform/v1/projects`: a new project (tenant) owned by the console account. Its API
keys are shown only in this response.

201.description: Project created; store its keys now

400.description: Invalid slug, name or site URL

401.description: Missing or invalid platform access token

409.description: Slug taken, or the account's project limit was reached

429.description: Too many projects created from this client

delete.summary:
`DELETE /platform/v1/projects/{project_id}`: deletes the project, its users and its
database. Owners only.

401.description: Missing or invalid platform access token

403.description: Not an owner of this project

post.summary:
`POST /platform/v1/projects/{project_id}/invitations`: invites someone to manage the
project as a member, and emails them. Owners only.

403.description: Not an owner of this project

409.description: Already a member, or already invited

delete.summary:
`DELETE /platform/v1/projects/{project_id}/invitations/{invitation_id}`: withdraws a
pending invitation. Owners only.

403.description: Not an owner of this project

delete.summary:
`DELETE /platform/v1/projects/{project_id}/members/{account_id}`: takes a member's access
away. Owners only; owners themselves cannot be removed.

403.description: Not an owner of this project

404.description: No such member (owners are never removed)

get.summary: `GET /platform/v1/projects/{project_id}/team`: who manages the project, and who is invited.

401.description: Missing or invalid platform access token

403.description: Not a member of this project

project_id.description: The project the account now belongs to.

ApiKeyKind.description: Publishable keys ship inside client apps; secret keys stay on the tenant's own servers.

ApiKeySummary.description: What an owner sees about a key: never the key itself, only its last characters.

hint.description: Last characters of the key; empty for keys created before hints existed.

name.description: The owner's label for the key; empty for keys created without one.

ConfiguredProvider.description: What an owner sees about a configured provider: its public client ID, never the secret.

name.description: A label to tell the key apart ("App iOS"); optional, up to 64 characters.

require_email_verification.description: Defaults to true: only verified emails can log in with a password.

EmailBody.description: Body of the endpoints that email a link to an address.

IssuedApiKey.description: A new key. Its plaintext is shown only here; afterwards only its hash exists.

LoginResponse.description: A session, or the MFA step that must come first.

code.description: The 6-digit code shown by the authenticator app.

MfaRequired.description: The first factor passed; with MFA on, a TOTP code is still needed at `POST /mfa/challenge`.

mfa_token.description: Short-lived token that identifies this login attempt at the challenge endpoint.

totp_enabled.description: Logins ask for a TOTP code.

totp_pending.description: An authenticator was added but its first code was not verified yet.

PendingInvitation.description: A pending invitation as the project's team sees it.

ProjectRole.description: What a platform account may do in a project: owners can also delete it.

ProjectSummary.description: A project (tenant) as one of its members sees it in the console.

ReceivedInvitation.description: An invitation as the invited console account sees it.

key_id.description: The `kid` of the key that now signs access tokens.

SessionSummary.description: One logged-in device or browser: a refresh token family that can still be used.

is_current.description: The session of the access token used for this request.

email.description: Format is checked by `EmailAddress::parse`, after trimming and lowercasing.

SignUpResponse.description: A session when the tenant lets unverified users in; otherwise only a note to check the inbox.

SmtpSettingsView.description: What the owner sees: where emails go, never the credentials.

is_custom.description: False while the tenant uses the platform's SMTP server.

TeamMember.description: A console account with access to the project.

email.description: As of the member's last console visit; empty until then.

can_manage.description: Whether the caller may invite and remove people (owners only).

TenantSettings.description: Settings a tenant manages itself with its secret key.

TotpEnrollmentResponse.description: The authenticator to add to an app; it becomes active after its first code is verified.

otpauth_uri.description: `otpauth://` URI, usually shown as a QR code.

secret.description: Base32 secret, for typing into an authenticator app by hand.

banned_at.description: Set while the user is banned: no login, no refresh.

mfa_enabled.description: A verified TOTP authenticator is required at login.

UserPage.description: One page of users, newest first, and how many match in total.

api_key.name: apikey
api_key.description: The tenant's publishable key (browser apps) or secret key (servers, admin routes)

platform_account.description: Access token of a console account (a user of the platform tenant)

project.name: x-nelcota-project
project.description: Id of the project a console account manages; it must be a member

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Signup, login and sessions of a tenant's users

tags.name: mfa
tags.description: TOTP second factor of a tenant's users

tags.name: sessions
tags.description: Devices where a user is logged in

tags.name: oauth
tags.description: Login with Google or GitHub through the tenant's own OAuth app

tags.name: tenant-admin
tags.description: A tenant's own configuration (secret API key)

tags.name: platform
tags.description: Projects of a console account (platform access token)

tags.name: platform-admin
tags.description: Operations of the platform operator (admin token)
